info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程在探討飛機升阻力、力距產生的原理和估算方法。首先探討相關流體的性質和標準大氣，應用的基本原理和理論公式，其次探討如何利用基本原理和公式應用於非壓縮性和壓縮性，非黏性流流經二維翼剖面與部份三維機翼的流場模擬，並計算相關的空氣動力，力和力距的數據。
description.describe_eh:
This course begins with discussion of fluid properties, models of standard atmosphere, aerodynamic forces and moments, then moves to the discussion of governing equations for fluid motion both in integral and differential form.
The second topic will be the modeling inviscid, incompressible flows around various shape bodies and some aerodynamic applications.
The third topic will be focused on geometry, characteristic parameters, and the performance of two dimensional airfoils, then part of the three dimension finite wings

targets.describe_ch: 了解空氣(流體)性質與基本觀念。
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of air properties and basic concepts.

targets.describe_ch: 了解流場守恆定律之應用與空氣動力學的處理方法
targets.describe_en: To realize the definition flow field and related basic equations and to understand how the aerodynamics forces are related to the air properties in a flow field.

targets.describe_ch: 瞭解無黏不可壓縮性和壓縮性流中之翼剖面與部份機翼之空氣動力特性。
targets.describe_en: To have an ability to calculate the lifts and moments of a 2-D airfoil and part of a 3-D wing in a nonviscous ,incompressible and compressible flow field.
